Contraction counter is an app that allows you to monitor the duration of your contractions and intervals between them and gives you the idea of when the baby is coming to the world.

SMART TIMER
By a simple button click, you start the timer when the contraction starts. After you click the button again to stop the timer, you can see the time of the interval counting.

INFORMATION
This application gives you a useful summary of important information about how the contractions work, how to measure them and when the best time to go to the hospital is.

HISTORY
Overview of the contractions and interval lengths are shown in one place so both you and your doctor can see the progress.

SHARE
Send an overview of your contractions to your doctor or birth assistant via email or any other way.

BABY ON THE WAY
When all the indications like contraction duration and interval length suggest the baby might be on its way, our app let’s you know.
